clips.title: The story
paras: Sir S. J. Erlgadin has set the final trial of his panther hunt before you in northern Stranglethorn Vale. Having proven your skill against the region's panthers, you are challenged to seek out Bhag'thera, an elusive predator that has so far eluded the expedition's party. Bringing back the beast's fang will establish your standing as a true master of the hunt.

At Nesingwary's Expedition, Sir S. J. Erlgadin considers your trials nearly complete. One final quarry remains to prove your worth against the jungle's predators: a panther named Bhag'thera. The beast has so far eluded the expedition's own party as it prowls the wilds of Stranglethorn Vale. Erlgadin calls on you to track down this great stalker and claim the Fang of Bhag'thera as proof of your skill.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You've almost proven yourself to be a master hunter of panthers. A panther by the name of Bhag'thera has been prowling the jungle. So far he's eluded our party. See if you can use your skills to kill the great Bhag'thera.
Bring me the Fang of Bhag'thera and you'll have earned my respect!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Bhag'thera can prove to be an elusive beast. How fares the hunt?

clips.title: Completion
paras: So the great Bhag'thera is dead! Cheers to you, friend. You are a mighty adventurer indeed!
